title: Explorit Science Center

services.name: summer camps
services.desc: Another summer camp season has come and gone, and we all had a blast! Campers attended our camps between June and August and learned about plants, animals, and space! With the generous donation of air purifiers by First Five Yolo we were able to hold our camps safely in our classroom, with plenty of time spent outdoor activities and walks through Mace Ranch Park. Need for Seeds had our campers learning about all thing’s plants, how they grow, what they need to survive, and about different varieties right in our backyard. Campers dissected seed sprouts, observed pinecones, counted tree rings, made oak gall ink, and planted their own seeds and sprouts to plant at home. Out of this World! took

services.name: School Programs
services.desc: Learn about Explorit's many offerings for kids, adults, teens, families, teachers and anyone who's curious about the world around them. Explorit's educators travel from Davis with hands-on programs to elementary schools in 12 to 18 counties each year. Invite Explorit into your classroom to provide guided hands-on and minds-on experiences for your students. These programs offers dynamic and stimulating science experiences for your entire elementary school

services.name: Discovery Lessons
services.desc: Transform potential energy into kinetic energy with a series of fun science challenges. Use gravity, engineering, and imagination to propel toy cars along tracks students build. Design a course made for a marble to travel from start to finish with no flaws. Learn how geologists identify rocks in a hands-on laboratory experience. Students will be introduced to rock classifications and will perform several experiments on mystery rock samples to determine their type. Investigate mysterious materials in our hands-on chemistry lab. Cause chemical reactions and see how things change. Make slime and fizzing concoctions as you experience the world of chemistry. Select one or all three options
